title: Kition Table Changed Event
description: table/changed: a notification the runtime sends on the kit bridge stream (GET /v1/kits/bridge) after a data-document transaction, undo, redo, or dashboard write lands, including ones this window made itself. A window ignores events whose change.origin is its own person:session:<uuid>, since it already applied that edit locally.

params.description: The transact/undo/redo TableChange (data-documents-transact.schema.json) plus the document's workspace-relative path.
